studies.title: The Inca road
studies.caption: Some 40,000 kilometres of roads, with stairways, suspension bridges and waystations a day apart, run from Ecuador to Chile.
studies.prompt: View along the woven-grass deck of an Inca suspension bridge around1500CE. A traveller walks away from the camera down the centre, physically inside the two side railings, with a sandalled foot planted on the deck and one hand on the right handrail. The bridge joins stone paths across an Andean gorge; braided plant-fibre cables and a continuous walkable surface remain clearly visible.
